Fig. 3 | Factors affecting the charge/discharge cycling behaviour of anode-free SSBs. a, An anode-free SSB after initial plating with a lithium layer of constant thickness. b, Spatially uniform stripping across the interface at relatively low current densities will lead to homogeneous lithium removal and can enable long cycle life. c, Stripping at relatively high current densities can cause voids to form at the interface (similar to lithium-excess cells), which can concentrate current to cause filament growth during the subsequent plating
